info.title: Assay
info.description: Code analysis CLI for AI agents — builds a queryable graph from C# solutions.

commands.name: batch
commands.description:
Run several queries against one loaded graph in a single invocation. Each <query> is one quoted mini command line (e.g.
"search Cascade --max 30"). Exits 0 even when individual queries fail (their status is in the output); 64 with zero
queries, 66 when the solution cannot be loaded

options.name: --coverage-build
options.description:
Where 'dotnet test' builds when collecting coverage: isolated (default, under the
assay cache) or in-place (reuse the repository's own build output); overrides
ASSAY_COVERAGE_BUILD

options.name: --msbuild-prop
options.description:
Forward an MSBuild property to 'dotnet test' as -p:Name=Value (repeatable), e.g.
--msbuild-prop CollectCoverage=true for a conditionally referenced coverage
package

options.name: --framework
options.description:
Pin every coverage run to one target framework (forwarded as --framework <tfm>);
default: every target the installed runtimes can execute

options.name: --coverage-parallel
options.description:
How many test projects run at once after the shared build (default: half the
cores, 2..8; overrides ASSAY_COVERAGE_PARALLEL); 1 runs them one at a time, e.g.
when test suites share a port or database

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Report which test projects would run 'dotnet test' (with the exact command
lines), be served from cache or imported, then exit without running anything

options.name: --top
options.description: Top N findings per category (default: 5)

options.name: --severity
options.description: Minimum severity to include (critical, high, medium, low) (default: low)

options.name: --skip
options.description:
Skip a category (repeatable): vulnerability, license, crap, coveragegap,
diagnostic, churn, structure

options.name: --fail-on
options.description:
Exit with code 2 if any finding is at or above this severity (critical, high,
medium, low)

options.name: --output
options.description:
Write a markdown+HTML report bundle to a directory
a glob matching nothing warns on stderr

options.name: --exclude-path
options.description:
Exclude paths matching a glob at any depth, e.g. "**/Migrations/**" (repeatable);
a glob matching nothing warns on stderr

options.name: --include-generated
options.description: Include code-generated members (excluded by default)

options.name: --msbuild-prop
options.description:
Forward an MSBuild property to 'dotnet test' as -p:Name=Value (repeatable), e.g.
--msbuild-prop CollectCoverage=true for a conditionally referenced coverage
package

options.name: --framework
options.description:
Pin every coverage run to one target framework (forwarded as --framework <tfm>);
default: every target the installed runtimes can execute

options.name: --coverage-parallel
options.description:
How many test projects run at once after the shared build (default: half the
cores, 2..8; overrides ASSAY_COVERAGE_PARALLEL); 1 runs them one at a time, e.g.
when test suites share a port or database

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Report which test projects would run 'dotnet test' (with the exact command
lines), be served from cache or imported, then exit without running anything

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the self-contained review page here (default: assay-review.html)

options.name: --base
options.description:
Diff against a git revision (e.g. origin/main): its merge-base with HEAD is
analyzed in a temporary worktree, enabling the Δ lens, focus areas, and blast
reach

options.name: --data
options.description: Also write the dataset JSON (input for 'assay viz summary')

options.name: --members
options.description: Include full per-member detail in the page (larger file)

options.name: --diagnostics
options.description: Include individual compiler diagnostics, not just the per-rule rollup

options.name: --no-restore
options.description:
Skip 'dotnet restore' of the base checkout (faster; base analysis degrades
without package assets)

options.name: --focus-top
options.description:
Focus-area rows in the summary (default: 8); a cap that truncates prints '+N
more', --json always carries every focus area
